items.title: 🔥 [資深] 3.5M/Y iOS/Android 軟體工程師 (全遠端) 🛠 Senior Mobile App Engineer (Remote) 🚀
items.description:
## **About Us**

We are a **rapidly growing software technology startup** from Silicon Valley, founded by top engineers from Stanford and MIT. Our dynamic team brings together extensive experience and diverse backgrounds in finance and consulting from New York, San Francisco, and Chicago. As a fully remote company, we offer a unique opportunity for exceptional individuals to join our team. We foster a culture that values both practicality and creativity, providing an meritocratic environment for you to showcase your skills and contribute to the creation of innovative products.

Are you seeking a company that transcends traditional constraints of location and time?

If you meet the following criteria, we want to work with you:

1. **Proactive and Independent:** Embrace the freedom to control your own working hours and enjoy the benefits of flexible schedules.
2. **Fully Remote:** Escape the confines of a traditional office setting and thrive in a fully remote work environment.
3. **Ownership and Involvement:** Crave a sense of involvement and autonomy, where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized.
4. **Strong Entrepreneurial Spirit:** High-energy, possess an adventurous and startup mindset, unafraid of embracing unknown challenges.
5. **Passion for the International Product:** Fuel your ambition by working on projects that transcend borders and embrace the opportunity to collaborate with teams across different parts of the world.

If you are driven, hard-working, and ready to make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and embark on an exciting journey of innovation and growth!

**APPLY NOW:** **https://linktr.ee/growaha**

# **Job Description**

As a Senior Mobile App Engineer, you'll play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining top-tier mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms. We're seeking an innovative thinker and experienced developer passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and high-performing applications.

### **Your Journey as a Senior Mobile App Engineer**

1. We focus primarily on iOS and Android for our mobile app development. While we prefer candidates with prior experience in iOS and/or Android app development, we're open to individuals with strong experience in other programming languages such as Swift, Objective-C, Java, or Kotlin.
2. Your role will involve using Xcode for iOS development and Android development environment. You'll work on the front-end mobile app development, closely interacting with our back-end frameworks to create seamless and efficient applications.

### **What You Bring**

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or related fields.
- A minimum of two years of professional experience or internships in mobile app development.
- Proficiency with Swift, Objective-C, Java, and Kotlin.
- Familiarity with Xcode for iOS development and the Android development environment.
- Experience in front-end mobile app development, particularly in interactions with back-end frameworks.
- Understanding of mobile application design patterns and User Interface (UI) API design.

**Extra Credentials**

- At least two years of experience in iOS and/or Android app development, with a portfolio of apps published on the App Store or Google Play.

By joining our team, you will have the unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing tech company. You'll be working with cutting-edge technologies and tools, alongside a team of talented and passionate professionals dedicated to creating top-tier mobile applications. You'll be challenged, inspired, and you'll grow your career as you contribute to our mission.

### Additional Qualifications

We are seeking individuals who possess the following qualifications:

1. **Self-Motivation and Ownership:** Demonstrate self-motivation, a passion for continuous learning, and the ability to manage your own work effectively.
2. **User-Centric Mindset:** Show a strong desire to meet user needs and a relentless pursuit of achievement and excellence.
3. **Adaptability and Quick Learning:** Exhibit a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to quickly learn new skills and adapt to unfamiliar domains.
4. **Collaborative Spirit:** Display a willingness to actively participate in the team environment and collaborate effectively with diverse team members.

### Competitive Compensation

We offer competitive salary levels; details can be found at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha). Our salary structure includes flexible working hours, a fully remote setup, and monthly performance-based raises, bonuses, and rewards. 

### This Job Offers You

When you join our team, you can expect:

1. **Flexible and Independent Remote Work:** Enjoy the freedom of flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely.
2. **Performance-Based Rewards:** Receive rewards and bonuses based on your performance and contributions.
3. **Driven and Talented Co-workers:** Collaborate with a group of driven, creative, and multi-talented colleagues who share a deep passion for startups.
4. **Ownership and Impact:** Take direct ownership of your role and responsibilities, making a meaningful impact in our innovative culture.
5. **Learn to Solve Challenging Issues:** Work closely with teams dedicated to creating solutions for some of the most relevant and challenging issues.
6. **Positive Work Environment:** Thrive in a work environment built on trust, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, fearlessness, kindness, and respect.

Please review our **Pre-Interview Info at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)** before applying.

Ready to join our team? **Apply now at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)**.

items.description:
## Descrição da vaga

A Abilitya, uma de tecnologia, está buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior especializado(a) em React Native para se juntar à nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Se você possui experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis, esta é uma oportunidade para você.

PS: Ingles NĀO é obrigatorio, mesmo recebendo em euro.

**Responsabilidades:**

 - Desenvolver aplicativos móveis utilizando React Native, garantindo a entrega de produtos de alta qualidade e performance.
 - Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com designers, analistas e outros membros da equipe de desenvolvimento para compreender os requisitos do projeto e garantir a implementação eficiente das funcionalidades.
 - Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código e colaborar com os membros da equipe para garantir a manutenibilidade e a qualidade do código.
 - Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho, usabilidade e compatibilidade de dispositivos.
 - Manter-se atualizado(a) com as últimas tendências e avanços em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis, especialmente na plataforma React Native.

## Local

100% remoto, horário flexível.

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**

- Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis utilizando React Native.
- Sólido conhecimento em JavaScript, incluindo conceitos avançados e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
- Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de depurar problemas complexos.
- Familiaridade com ferramentas de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

**Requisitos Opcionais (serão considerados diferenciais):**
 
- Experiência sólida em testes automatizados para aplicativos móveis, utilizando frameworks como Jest, Detox ou similares.
- Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis nativos (iOS/Android).
- Conhecimento em outras tecnologias relacionadas, como React.js, Redux, TypeScript, Firebase, entre outras.
- Participação em projetos de código aberto ou contribuições para a comunidade de desenvolvedores.

## Contratação
PJ entre [€2000 - €2800] inicial líquido. Impostos do modelo empresarial brasileiro (7,68%) sendo pagos além deste valor. Ajuste de até 6% anual + bonus por performance.

## Como se candidatar
Por favor envie um email para guilherme@abilitya.tech com o título "Vaga React Senior" com seu GitHub e linkedin.

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

Costumamos enviar feedbacks no máximo até 2 dias após cada processo.

## Labels

#### Alocação
- Remoto

#### Regime
- PJ

#### Nível
- Senior

items.title: REMOTE - LEAD ENGINEER
items.description:
## Location

* Remote

## Salary Expectation

* Negotiate

## Requirements
- Minimum of 10 years of experience in a technical role, with at least 3 years as a Technical Architect.
- Expertise in mobile app development technologies such as React Native, Swift, or Kotlin.
- Strong knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience in deploying applications in the cloud.
- Proficiency in coding best practices, code reviews, and agile development methodologies.
- Previous experience in successful start-ups is highly desirable.
- Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
- Ability to drive innovation and handle multiple priorities and deadlines.

Plus: 
- Experience with edtech domain is preferred.
- Previous experience in product scaling is a plus.

### Responsibilities

ELSA is the smartest Speech AI, backed by Google, on a mission to enable 1.5 billion language learners around the globe to speak English with full confidence and unlock their opportunities in life. ELSA is also Top 5 Best Artificial Intelligence Apps by Research Sniper, and Top 4 Companies Using AI To Transform The World by Forbes.

We are currently seeking a highly-skilled Engineering Lead with a minimum of 10 years of technical experience, to oversee the technical aspects of our product. This role is crucial to our company and involves working closely with Engineering Managers and the Engineering Director. The ideal candidate should have a strong technical background, preferably with experience in successful start-ups, and will be responsible for guiding the technical direction of our mobile app product in the edtech.

Responsibilities:
- Define and implement technical strategies for the product.
- Oversee the architecture of mobile applications and ensure scalability, reliability, and security.
- Work closely with Engineering Managers and Engineering Director to ensure alignment with company objectives.
- Provide technical leadership and guidance to the engineering teams.
- Drive innovation and efficiency in the engineering processes.
- Join during the product’s scale-up phase and contribute significantly to its growth.
- Ensure that technical decisions align with product and business goals.

### Why it would be awesome to work with us
Where you'll be
- We are a distributed workforce with offices in Silicon Valley, Portugal and Vietnam. 
- Where in the world? For this role, we are looking for someone in Asia, which can overlap time with our global teams.
- This is a remote role, with opportunities to travel. 
- Equity/bonus options are available.
### Process:
4 rounds, including meeting with the Board of Directors.
Report to: VP of Product and Engineering

### Contact
Skype: Huehuenoivu

items.description:

Somos uma HRTech e nosso propósito é criar ambientes de trabalho mais felizes, tudo isso através de um software completo de gestão de pessoas humanizado! Por isso, começar pelo nosso próprio ninho é tão importante! Somos Parrots determinados e que se importam uns com os outros, a sede de resultado é latente e o feedback sincero é rotina.

Estamos conquistando coisas incríveis! Crescemos quase 200% em 2022 e continuamos evoluindo em 2023, tudo isso através de um clima animado, com muito desenvolvimento e respeito para todos! (Se quiser conhecer melhor nosso ninho, voa pra cá: https://www.feedz.com.br/vagas/) 💙 Quer mais? Estamos no modelo totalmente remoto, então você pode fazer parte do nosso ninho no conforto da sua casa!!

Aqui na Feedz valorizamos muito a diversidade e queremos Parrots que queiram voar conosco, independente da etnia, gênero, sexualidade, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência! Quer crescer com a gente? Vem pro ninho 💛

🔎 DESAFIOS DO TIME:

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para o cargo de Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior(PHP) que irá atuar no nosso time de Produto, trabalhando diretamente com nossos tech leads e CTO, resolvendo desafios que impactam mais de 150 mil usuários diretamente e nos ajudando a evoluir a senioridade do time.Aqui trabalhamos para construir um produto escalável e altamente focado na performance, sempre utilizando boas práticas de código e arquitetura limpa!

📅 ETAPAS DO PROCESSO:

Para essa posição, temos as seguintes etapas para avaliação:

Triagem de currículo;
Bate papo técnico;
Bate papo cultural;
Contratação!
Para entender melhor sobre cada etapa e como funciona nosso processo seletivo, acesse nosso playbook da pessoa candidata: https://bit.ly/3EWnroW

📚Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Aplicar boas práticas alinhadas com o time no desenvolvimento (criando códigos coerentes e alinhados ao Clean Code; desenvolvendo com foco em segurança, patterns, CI/CD, automação, etc);
Desenvolver novos módulos na plataforma e auxiliar nas definições de arquitetura;
Identificar pontos de melhoria na performance da base instalada;
Desenvolvimento e aplicação de testes automatizados;
Mentorear o time de desenvolvimento em parceria com tech leads;
Fazer a gestão da informação das demandas atualizando o status dos projetos.
🎯Pré-requisitos:

Aproximadamente 7 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento web (Full stack com vivência em PHP e VueJS) em produtos digitais;
Experiência com sistemas de alto volume de dados;
Vivência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e/ou aceitação);
Vivência em times de tecnologia.
✨Benefícios:

100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao trabalho presencial!!)
Vale Comida (R$700)
Plano de Saúde Unimed(subsidiado pela Feedz)
Plano odontológico Nacional da Bradesco Dental(subsidiado pela Feedz)
Auxílio Parrot Feliz (R$100/mês de investimento no desenvolvimento pessoal, saúde física ou mental do Parrot)
Auxílio Contas (R$160/mês)
Auxílio Parrot Casamenteiro(R$250 quando Parrots casam)
Auxílio Ninhada(R$250 no nascimento ou adoção de pequenos Parrots)
Happy Bird(day) (um dia de folga no mês de aniversário)
Licença paternidade estendida(21 dias)
Licença maternidade estendida(6 meses)
Ifood Office(voucher para usar dentro do app em alguns eventos internos)
Para você ter um voo com conforto, na Feedz oferecemos um auxílio de R$1.000 (pagamento único) para materiais, como mesa e cadeira, para seu home office e enviamos todos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários!

💰 Salário a combinar (CLT)
40 horas semanais

items.title: [London] Senior UI/UX Designer na CodeLeap
items.description:
Vaga de Senior UX/UI Designer na CodeLeap

- Introdução

Fala pessoal! Tudo bem? 
Somos a CodeLeap, uma pequena agência de desenvolvimento de software com sede e clientes em Londres (Reino Unido) e estamos procurando um(a) Senior UX/UI Designer para se juntar ao time.

A vaga é para um Senior que já tenha experiência com processos que envolvem a criação do zero de UX/UI, projetos web, mobile e web apps responsivos. Algumas de suas atividades são ajudar no design de produtos dos clientes, coordenar funções com nosso time de designers, participar junto da liderança a idealizar o escopo desde o início do projeto , construir a identidade da nossa empresa no longo prazo. Você terá grandes responsabilidades e a oportunidade de tomar decisões importantes dentro da empresa, tanto em relação ao design, quanto em usabilidade e outros aspectos dos projetos.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal é alguém jovem que curte tecnologia, websites, aplicativos, é minimalista e é apaixonado(a) por UX/UI.
Com relação ao inglês, exigimos nível intermediário, (leitura, escrita e conversação básica) toda documentação da empresa é feita em inglês e ocasionalmente você irá manter contato com clientes e seus feedbacks.

O foco da CodeLeap é o design e desenvolvimento de produtos digitais, websites e aplicativos para iOS e Android sob demanda. Cada projeto exige um approach diferente e traz novos desafios. Sempre temos algo diferente pra fazer! No médio e longo prazo temos interesse em desenvolver nossos próprios produtos, então se você gosta da ideia de experimentar internamente e criar coisas novas, você encontrou o lugar certo!


- Local

Remoto - Central em Londres, Reino Unido

- Remuneração

Salário baseado na média do mercado, varia de acordo com a experiência.
Saiba mais em https://bit.ly/3twAS95


- Diferenciais

Sem horário ou local de trabalho, o que importa é fazer acontecer!
Equipe flexível, espaço para crescimento na empresa
Habilidade de aprender coisas novas e descobrir em quais funções você se vê mais produtivo e satisfeito.

- Requisitos

Obrigatórios:

Ter experiência com design de:
Landing pages
Mobile apps
Web apps responsivos
Conhecimento avançado no Figma
Branding e ilustrações
Gerenciamento de equipes

Desejo em aprender - nós somos um time pequeno. Isso significa que provavelmente você terá que fazer um pouco de tudo também. Por isso é necessário que você goste de aprender coisas novas para conseguir lidar com os desafios.

Boa comunicação - Nós precisamos fazer muitas coisas e contamos com nossos companheiros para isso. Não há problema em sentir dificuldades nos projetos, mas você deve pedir ajuda quando não conseguir resolver um problema.

Inglês intermediário - nossos clientes são falantes da língua inglesa e toda documentação da empresa é escrita em inglês.

- Desejáveis:

Web skill
"Sangue no olho"
Ingles fluente
Flexibilidade de horário
Proatividade
Experiência em relação com cliente


- Benefícios:

Aula de conversação de inglês toda semana.
Sistema de bonificação por produtividade de até o 14º salário.
Possibilidade de participação acionária de projetos para cargos de maiores responsabilidades (stock options)


- Contratação

PJ a combinar, somos flexíveis
Início nas próximas semanas após processo seletivo
Período full-time

items.description:
## About Cryptape

People tend to see blockchain as coins. In Cryptape, however, we believe that the blockchain is capable of reframing trust. Cryptape is a distributed team with most members working remotely. We create trust with technology, provide infrastructure and services for the nascent crypto economy and opensource everything we created. We independently design and implement protocols, and we are the architects and engineers of our own future.
Cryptape encourages knowledge sharing and participates in many key dev events to foster innovation, and we are convinced that innovation can emerge from every member of our team.

### About the Role

As a Developer Relations Specialist, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our developer community. This will include engaging with developers through various channels (e.g. social media, forums, meetups, etc.), providing technical support and guidance, and helping to grow our developer community.

## Responsibilities
- Engage with developers through various channels (e.g. social media, forums, meetups, etc.) to build and maintain strong relationships with our developer community
- Provide technical support and guidance to developers working on Nervos CKB
- Write document and educational content for CKB and tooling
- Help to grow CKB developer community by organizing and participating in events, workshops, and other activities
- Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to gather feedback from developers and incorporate it into our product development process
- Monitor industry trends and developments to stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and best practices in the blockchain space

## Requirements
- Strong understanding of blockchain technology and the development of decentralized applications
- Experience working with a developer community and providing technical support
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
- Passion for advancing the adoption of blockchain technology and empowering developers to build innovative solutions.
- Fluent in both English and Chinese, solid writing skills

## Nice to Haves
- Solid programming skills and developing experience
- Experience managing/operating a developer community
- Passion for building relationships and growing communities online

## Projects Involved
Nervos CKB：The Nervos Network is a layered blockchain network for tomorrow’s crypto economy. https://github.com/nervosnetwork/ckb is the layer 1 of Nervos Network, a public permissionless blockchain.

## Job Nature

- Full-time or not: Full-time
- Remote or not: Remote

## Salary and Benefits

Salary：70k - 120k usd 

- 100% remote, contribute from anywhere in the world
- Welcome package & gifts of holidays
- Competitive health insurance
- Leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
- Generous PTO / sick days
- Generous remote work stipends
- Professional development reimbursement
- Sponsored Team Building

## Work Location
Preferred based in US

## Contact
email：join@cryptape.com

items.title: [FULLY REMOTE] Fullstack developers wanted for Web3 tokenization platform
items.description:
## Location

* Fully remote position (part-time or full-time)
* Company is based in Southeast Asia

## Job Overview

Our company tokenizes assets to make them tradeable on the blockchain. We are looking for 1-2 developers to build a complete asset tokenization platform that includes:

* Website / landing page with Team, Docs, FAQs, etc.
* Basic account creation and login
* Interface with a third-party KYC platform
* Investment dashboard so customers can see their holdings’ performance
* ERC-20 token representing customers’ collateralized claim to the underlying assets
* Basic buy / sell functionality for the token
* Interface with external wallets (e.g. Metamask)

Eligible candidates can be part-time or full-time, but we want to be able to get the platform to beta within 3 months, followed by 1-2 months of security audit and penetration testing with an external security firm. 

Candidates will be managed by our CTO, and should generally be available during business hours for quick calls and check-ins. We do respect candidates’ time and are not looking to micromanage - we actually want candidates who can work very autonomously. We are likely to establish a weekly “formal” check-in cadence.

## Skills and Requirements

* At least 3-5 years experience as a developer (fintech / banking experience a plus)
* At least 2 years experience in Web3, with experience creating smart contracts
* Familiarity with NextJS, Typescript, and Solidity (open to other languages as well)

Creating a great-looking and easy-to-use UI / UX is very important to us so candidates should be able to point to past projects that demonstrate sleek design and attractive aesthetics.

## Why Candidates Should Apply

We are a new startup growing in the emerging and fast-growing asset tokenization space. We are on a mission to democratize access for investment products (bonds, stocks, ETFs, SME loans) for everyone, not just the few, and bring the promise of DeFi to the world (really 😄).  

* CEO has deep experience in TradFi and investing. He came from private equity and has his MBA from MIT
* CTO is very experienced in managing global projects in both Web2 and Web3 and previously ran a dev agency

As traction for our products builds, we are keen for our developers to consider coming onboard full-time! We are passionate about our work but otherwise don’t take ourselves too seriously and want to create a work environment that is fun and productive for everyone.

## Compensation

US$1.5-2K / month / person, negotiable based on experience

## Contact

Hisham
Telegram: @ayersuam

items.description:
運點科技

職位：軟硬整合工程師

薪資：50k~90k

職位概述：
我們正在尋找一名熟悉Node.js並有興趣往系統韌體發展的工程師，以協助我們開發創新的產品並為客戶提供最佳的解決方案。
這個職位需要與多個團隊協作，包括硬體工程師、前後端工程師和產品經理。

以Node.js為核心開發並維護T-Box系統軟體及產測程式,並解決軟硬體整合所產生的相關問題(還有Unitest需求)。
與產品經理和其他團隊成員協調，確定產品需求並定義系統整合方案。

GPIO/UART/I2C/SPI/BLE/WiFi/CAN/RFID/Socket/MQTT/D-Bus
加分項目
熟C/C++
熟Linux系統管理
能看懂基本電路
用RPi或MCU(Arduino/ESP32)做過Side Project
具有良好的溝通和協調能力，能夠與不同專業背景的團隊成員協作。
有解決問題的能力，能夠快速適應新技術和環境。
能夠獨立工作和承擔責任，並能夠在壓力下交付高質量的工作成果。
有良好的英語能力，包括口語和書面溝通，能夠與國際客戶和供應商進行交流。
